title: Second independent cross-model ADR-0020 audit of the candidate @ 6812cc0b
description:
Second independent, cross-model, maximum-effort audit of the ADR-0020 SRD candidate after the eshyra-o9bd.16 blocker repairs (#699-#703, report #704). It is a prerequisite of acceptance (eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4); it does not reopen eshyra-o9bd.16 and does not create a second freeze lifecycle (re-freeze stays eshyra-o9bd.14).

CANDIDATE (pinned): main merge commit 6812cc0b89daa0e2503cd06521ec5c60a7103651 (tree 1a6589e87ab3db274fc8c70e3b8de8ce53eec139). records.json sha256 ef9f51a1cae0a7ee12e04b8ba40a54a951f6e413d96c07639b4a388a262bd83a; pack manifest.json sha256 36e6e529ea7b88f10eec3985cd1888bb42d7cc3b958f5eb266d60ee65c39070a; vendored SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf sha256 2504d2a0abb0a4d491a939be4f17910a2dde0312570ab8d208080225ccf0a1f0 (matches packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json). Every auditor audits this SHA, never a moving main.

AUDITORS (one child bead each; overlapping scopes, independent investigation): GPT-6 via ChatGPT (broad: source fidelity, discovery, architectural consistency); Opus 5.5 local Claude Code (vertical: real execution paths, state integrity, persistence, replay); Fable 5.1 Claude Code Cloud (source-to-pack fidelity, provenance, discovery, readiness, adjudication support); GPT-6.1 Sol via Codex (deep adversarial capability, identity, mutation, migration, state integrity); GPT-6 Astra via Codex (bounded cross-boundary adversarial audit).

AUTHORITY given to every auditor: AGENTS.md; ADR 0020 and section 5.9 of docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md (nine-condition bounded truthfulness bar, NOT universal completeness); docs/design-and-pr-review-policy.md (From observation to finding; Findings discipline); docs/rules-pack-compiler.md; docs/importer-fix-protocol.md; finding-registry.json; the candidate's in-tree audit docs. Prior reports (incl. the o9bd.16 report) are evidence, not conclusions or a checklist.

INDEPENDENCE: no auditor receives another auditor's findings before it submits. Auditors must not read sibling child beads of this bead. The Captain does not relay findings between auditors.

FINDING PROMOTION: a finding is admitted only with (1) governing invariant + authority, (2) concrete evidence at the pinned SHA (record key or file:line; SRD page + quote where printed rules govern), (3) reachability/applicability, (4) actual consequence, (5) sibling analysis (same defect class elsewhere), (6) proportionate closure condition and evidence. Otherwise it is dispositioned "no requirement" in one line. Disclosed limits stay limits.

RETENTION: each auditor's report is recorded on its own child bead (Codex/local via bd; ChatGPT and Fable reports are committed artifacts or verbatim transcriptions recorded by the Captain with source attribution).

RECONCILIATION (Captain, after all submissions): de-duplicate by defect class; verify every claimed finding against the pinned SHA; classify BLOCKER / NON-BLOCKER / NO-REQUIREMENT / LIMIT; cross-check against the o9bd.16 registry of repaired classes (recurrence); each blocker gets an owning bead that blocks eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4; consolidated report under docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/.

NON-SCOPE: no pack/engine modification during audit, no repair PRs from auditors, no freeze authorization.
design:
2026-11-01 PREPARATION (Claude Captain). Launch artifacts (local, gitignored): .worktrees/.dispatch/eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.{common.md,1..5.prompt,cloud-setup.sh,cloud-env.txt}. Every lane prompt embeds the identical shared charter (pinned identity, authority, bar, independence, promotion rule, report format).

BUNDLE PROCEDURE (reuse audit-bundle:dnd5e-srd, no new tooling): git worktree add --detach .worktrees/<name> 6812cc0b89daa0e2503cd06521ec5c60a7103651; cd there; npm_config_build_from_source=false npm ci; npm run audit-bundle:dnd5e-srd -- <outdir> <zipcopy>. Pass both args (the default zip copy target is /mnt/d). Requires Node 24, zip on PATH; Dolt optional (its tests skip when absent). The bundle is reproducible in content, not bytes (generatedAt timestamp, absolute repoRoot, captured logs). Compare bundles by metadata.commitSha, source hash, pack hashes and gate results. Source archive for ChatGPT: git archive --format=zip --prefix=eshyra-6812cc0b/ 6812cc0b... (deterministic for a given git version).

LAUNCH PLAN: A4 Sol and A5 Astra via dispatch-codex.sh into worktrees/branches named after their beads at the pinned SHA (max 2 Codex concurrent); A2 Opus in a fresh local session in .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.2 with repo hooks disabled; A3 Fable in a Claude Code Cloud session on a dedicated environment (setup script installs Node 24 + zip + poppler; ESHYRA_SEAT_ROLE=dispatched-worker); A1 ChatGPT GPT-6 with uploaded bundle zip + source zip. Fable's report is retained as one file on a pushed report-only branch audit/eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.3-fable (no PR); ChatGPT's as the returned Markdown. The Captain records both verbatim on their beads with attribution (bd is unavailable to those auditors).

RECONCILIATION (Captain, only after all lanes submit or are recorded as not run):
1. Collect each report; check its IDENTITY block names the pinned SHA and hashes (a report on another SHA is evidence only).
2. Normalize every claimed finding into one table: lane, claim, invariant+authority, evidence, reachability, consequence, siblings.
3. De-duplicate by defect class, not wording; record which auditors found each class independently (agreement is confidence, not proof; a single-auditor finding is not discounted).
4. Re-verify every candidate finding at the pinned SHA myself (reproduce the probe, read the SRD page). Disposition: BLOCKER (owning bead, blocks 19.6.4) / NON-BLOCKER (owning bead or existing owner) / NO REQUIREMENT (one line: missing invariant or authority) / LIMIT (disclosed, not a defect) / REFUTED (with evidence).
5. Apply ADR 0020 bounded bar: no finding is promoted for lack of universal completeness; a disclosed engine-pending/adjudicated clause is not a defect; an SRD contradiction always is.
6. Check recurrence of o9bd.16 and registry classes; a recurrence means the earlier repair did not close the class and its owner is reopened via a new bead, not by reopening closed beads.
7. Disagreements between auditors on the same object: decide on the artifact, record both positions.
8. Write docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/<date>-o9bd-19-6-7-second-independent-audit.md (per-lane result, findings with dispositions, limits, non-claims). It does not authorize re-freeze.
9. Close this bead when every lane is dispositioned and the report merges; 19.6.4 then decides acceptance.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every auditor audited exactly 6812cc0b89daa0e2503cd06521ec5c60a7103651 and recorded its identity checks, method, findings and LIMITS on its child bead (or the bead records why an auditor did not run).
- Every reported finding is reconciled and dispositioned (BLOCKER with owning bead blocking eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4 / NON-BLOCKER with owner / no requirement / disclosed limit), with the promotion evidence above.
- Reconciliation records cross-auditor agreement and disagreement, and any recurrence of an o9bd.16 repaired class.
- A consolidated report states bounded scope and non-claims; it does not authorize re-freeze (that is eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4).
